title: Fix auto-generated contribution ID failing safe_id validation
problem: tools/orgctl.py record-contribution without --id generates contrib-{YYYYMMDDTHHMMSS}-{employee_id}, which includes uppercase T and fails safe_id() lowercase kebab-case validation, so automatic contribution recording cannot succeed.
desired_outcome: record-contribution without --id creates a schema-valid contribution whose auto-generated id satisfies safe_id; explicit valid ids continue to work; explicit invalid ids continue to be rejected; unrelated identifier formats unchanged.
evidence: CLI without --id: SystemExit 'contribution id must be lowercase kebab-case'
CLI with --id contrib-repro-valid-20260920: wrote workforce/contributions/contrib-repro-valid-20260920.yaml (removed after copy to evidence/)
acceptance_criteria: record-contribution without --id creates a schema-valid contribution file
Auto-generated ID satisfies safe_id / lowercase kebab-case
No unrelated identifier formats change (prefer contribution-only fix)
non_goals: Changing checkpoint ID behavior unless a shared helper is demonstrably required
Version bump / release solely for this fix
